Usage: memoriahub sync [options] [folder...]

Incremental sync: skip already-uploaded files, process new/changed files

Arguments:
  folder             Paths to folders to sync (omit to use --all)

Options:
  --all              Sync all registered enabled folders (default: false)
  --dry-run          Show what would be uploaded without actually uploading
                     (default: false)
  -r, --recursive    Descend into sub-directories (when auto-registering a
                     folder) (default: false)
  --concurrency <n>  Number of concurrent upload workers
  --circle <id>      Target circle ID (overrides active circle in config)
  --scan <id>        Reconcile against a prior scan (id or "latest") and report
                     changes since then
  --from <date>      Only sync media captured on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD,
                     local, inclusive)
  --to <date>        Only sync media captured on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD,
                     local, inclusive)
  -h, --help         display help for command
